The council's page and its PDF guide disagree on a few details (for example which Sundays the trunk fair runs, and whether the Happy Life market opens on Sunday), so confirm with the market before you go. Another page says the market is open from 6:30 am to 2:00 am every day, which only applies to the restaurants and stalls that are open at those hours.
